- One-time POC credit: Acme asked for a clear ceiling (they expect a letter to finance).
- Discount tiers: they want committed monthly spend -> discount mapping.
- Timeline: aiming to close by 05/31 (aggressive).
- SLA exceptions: procurement wants to surface any nonstandard items now.

Proposal / ask of this thread:
1) Finance: can we approve up to $75k one-time credit for a 6-week POC contingent on a 6-month commit? (Marissa)
2) Sales/AE: confirm commit sizing we should be asking for to hit that credit at the agreed unit economics (Neha).
3) Leadership: if we need an SLA carve (availability SLA or data-retention language), what is the escalation path (Rishi)?

Action items I propose this week (owners):
- Draft short MAP (milestones+dates) for Acme — owner: Neha (due Tue 05/18)
- Finance confirm credit ceiling + approval path — owner: Marissa (due Wed 05/19)
- Prepare fallback pricing (smaller commit, smaller credit) — owner: Soojin (due Thu 05/20)
- Draft response to procurement with timeline & DocuSign link — owner: Soojin (due Fri 05/21)

Soojin / Neha — quick finance readout below. We can support a one-time POC credit but need the following to route for approval:

1) Proposed credit ceiling: $50k standard; up to $75k requires VP approval and confirmed 6-month minimum commit at our proposed ARPU.
2) Documentation needed: signed MAP with milestone acceptance criteria, expected usage profile (tokens/day estimate), and contact for invoicing.
3) SLA exceptions: any SLA carve for data retention or dedicated egress logs increases the cost baseline; we need a justification from the account team.

If you want the $75k route, I'll prepare the approval memo — I need Neha to confirm the expected commit and ARR math by EOD Wednesday. If Neha confirms the conservative commit (6mo @ $25k/mo) we'll push VP approval on Thursday.

Marissa Cole

Team — quick decision so we can reply to Acme Monday morning. I reviewed the numbers and support going up to $75k one-time credit conditional on the following:

- Commit profile: minimum 6 months at $25k/month (total committed $150k).
- MAP milestones: POC completion + acceptance signoff at week 6; production rollout start at month 2.
- Acceptance criteria: Acme to provide token volume estimate and three evaluation prompts for quality gates.
- SLA carve: no changes to core availability SLA; we can offer a limited log-retention exception (30 days) for the pilot but note it in the approval memo.

Owners and next steps (finalized):
- Neha: deliver final MAP doc with milestones, dates, acceptance criteria — due Mon 05/24 EOD.
- Marissa: prepare VP approval memo for $75k credit (I'll review) — due Thu 05/27.
- Soojin: prepare and send short reply to procurement + DocuSign path (include both $50k standard and $75k approved path) — due Mon 05/24 AM.

I will also loop legal if they need to update the SLA appendix before signature. Good work keeping this tight.
